content: Un'naaŋ a Dweelà anà an'buuŋ
Ntɔn sye, u mbwo a nsyääm, bi ban'kaar isal aki bi ikwamà anki.

Wɛɛ bi kan'tɔn an'yee a nswɛn, bi, bi ifàsyääl anki impeenà anà bi ifàbübünà anki Ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ mumɛɛy ndandaa ubwaŋàbwaŋ, waa bi ifàswɛɛŋ bi ŋakwo u nsyeebà a mbuur wanswà kusà a Nzam.
Isàkal naa apà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ abi làŋàfwe, la làŋàfwe ntɔn baar bàfàdiimà,
ntɔn baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà, waa nzam a mɛɛn mà kàsi làpib unsà un'yɛnà ntɔn baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aman kyɛɛy a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ alà làkoo a Klistɔ, awà imɛɛy a Nzam.
Ntɔn, kà bi ŋakwo anki bi ifàkyään, wɛɛ bi ifàkyään naa Yɛsu Klistɔ wà Mwol anà bi ŋakwo ibà asyääl abɛ ntɔn Yɛsu.
Ntɔn Nzam awà kàtɛn naa: « Pɛɛlà làsànyäŋ uboo a làpib! », wà Nde ŋakwo kànyäŋ u mpem abi, ntɔn ngyööb a làkoo ande ipɛ kyɛɛy u ntabwey a Klistɔ.
Wɛɛ, un'naaŋ awà, bi wa ifàsyen unsà an'buuŋ, ntɔn ngwal aŋàsöönà ayi ikäl yà Nzam, wɛɛ kà yà bi anki.
Bi ibà aŋàküünà mper yanswà, wɛɛ bi kibà aŋàbwanà anki, unsà lingyoomà, wɛɛ bi ilwom anki làkyän,
bakyer afilab, wɛɛ bàfikaar anki, bàkyer afidüb, wɛɛ bàfimaay anki,
taaŋ lanswà ndür abi ye anà nkweel a Yɛsu ntɔn naa mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ukäl sye wàŋàmɛnà u ndür abi.
Kyakin, taaŋ lanswà, bi aŋamɔ̈ɔ̈, bàkiyälà kukwà ntɔn Yɛsu, ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Yɛsu sye umɛnà u ndür abi yukwà.
Abun, ukwà bàmukyer isal amu bi, wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu bɛ.
Kyekà, asànaa ibà bi anà Dweelà mwɛy la, dweelà a làkwikilà, abun bàsön naa: « Mɛ kàsi làkwikilà, kyakin kàyäm mɛ », bi sye, bi kan'sà làkwikilà, kyakin waa bi iyäämà.
Ntɔn bi ikyàyöb, mbuur kàwiiy Mwol Yɛsu, nde sye akyer afàsiwiiy anà Yɛsu, waa usisà anà bɛ tsütsü apà nde.
Ntɔn indiir abi byanswà byàyi ntɔn bɛ, ntɔn kab a ngway làbɛy, waa làsweey an'tɔɔn a baar mbɔɔn ntɔn làkoo a Nzam.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ unsà làkwikilà
Kyakin, bi iyɔn anki, itàkal naa amu bi, imbuur a nsà kyàmutay ikye ikye, imbuur a boo ifàbulà kyàkün ilä a ilä.
Ntɔn, mpay mbɔɔn imanà bi yi, yikaay anà yàlyaŋ, kusà a làkoo a kölàköl là mbul a in'tye kilɔ̈ɔ̈nà mpay mbɔɔn ayi.
Abun, isin a an'kyän abi kà kyà unsà indiir byàfàmɛnà anki, wɛɛ unsà indiir mpa bàfàman. Indiir bàfàman byàfàlam anki, wɛɛ undiir mpa bàfàman byàfàlam mbul a in'tye.
